title: Detailed yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Yo-yo string -->
  <path d='M50 8 Q52 14 51 22' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Yo-yo body - two halves with 3D depth -->
  <!-- Left half back -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#2A9D8F'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='22' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#3DD9CA' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Right half back -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#2A9D8F'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='22' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#3DD9CA' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Left half face (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='53' rx='19' ry='21' fill='#48C9B0'/>
  
  <!-- Right half face (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='53' rx='19' ry='21' fill='#48C9B0'/>
  
  <!-- Center axle / hub -->
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='14' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#F9E79F' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Axle shine -->
  <rect x='46' y='50' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#FCF3CF' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Left decorative rings -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='53' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#F4D03F' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='53' rx='7' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='53' r='3' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  
  <!-- Right decorative rings -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='53' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#F4D03F' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='53' rx='7' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='53' r='3' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  
  <!-- Left half highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='44' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#A3E4D7' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Right half highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#A3E4D7' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Edge detail - rim shine left -->
  <path d='M18 48 Q22 35 32 34' fill='none' stroke='#A3E4D7' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Edge detail - rim shine right -->
  <path d='M82 48 Q78 35 68 34' fill='none' stroke='#A3E4D7' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Small dots around edge for detail -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#F4D03F'/>
  
  <!-- String loop at top -->
  <path d='M47 8 Q50 4 53 8' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Cute sparkle -->
  <path d='M78 28 L80 24 L82 28 L86 30 L82 32 L80 36 L78 32 L74 30 Z' fill='#F9E79F' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Small star -->
  <path d='M18 24 L19 21 L20 24 L23 25 L20 26 L19 29 L18 26 L15 25 Z' fill='#A3E4D7' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
